content: 1. The fellow who contributes significant content to a page should be listed as the first author. 2. If a fellow makes relevant edits to a previously written page, they may add their name after the first author. 3. If the entire page is copied from other sources, both the content and the name of the author may be removed. 4. If there is no content on the page, the name of the author may also be removed. 5. If a fellow is reviewing the language and grammar of a page, they may add their name using the Grammar Reviewer template. 1. To qualify as an active scholar, all of the following criteria must be met (note that meaningless edits in the sandbox will not be counted): Completion of a chapter within a two-week timeframe. Responsiveness to emails and text messages posted in the group. Providing weekly updates to the coach regarding the progress of the assigned project. Meeting the criteria of a grade B or higher as per the Letter of Recommendation standards for all listed qualities. Making corrections to the page as instructed by the reviewer. Avoiding inactivity for more than three consecutive weeks.
